newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real rises 0.01 pct in listless trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real rises 0.01 pct in listless trade.

text.p: Brazil's real closed at 1.0776 per dollar, up 0.01 percent in listless trade in the commercial foreign exchange market largely due to the Independece Day holiday in the United States, dealers said.
"Nothing happened other than (the afternoon) buy tender," one trader said.
At 1550 local/1850 GMT the Central Bank bought dollars at 1.0775 per greenback to drain the excess supply of dollar in the market, dealers said.
In the first three days of July, financial and commercial forex contracts accumulated a $336.3 million surplus.
After Friday's Central Bank buy tender, dealers expect more volatilitty in the forex market next week.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0832 per dollar, up 0.01 percent. In the parallel market, the real closed unchanged at 1.135 per dollar, traders said.
